Subject: Mid-cycle GPU burst — proration & VAT question

Hi Sofia,

We need to kick off a short GPU burst this month: +8 A100-equivalent GPU slots for 7 days (deploy window 2026-12-14 to 2026-12-20) to support a performance test. Can you confirm how Redwood will invoice that mid-cycle add-on? Specifically:

- Will the charge be pro-rated based on days used (we're expecting 7/31 days)?
- Can you provide a pro-forma invoice we can PO and approve quickly?
- NovaForge is EU (Spain) — our VAT ID is ESB12345678. Will you zero-rate this as intra-EU or do you need any other documents?

Also, there was an unused reserved burst credit on our account from October; is it possible to apply that credit against this charge? If needed I can share the PO and VAT docs.

Thanks — want to get this live by next week.

Best,

Subject: Re: Mid-cycle GPU burst — proration & VAT question

Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the VAT ID. Quick answers up front, then a short pro-forma attached.

- Proration model: we charge pro-rata by day for capacity add-ons when they are added mid-cycle. For an 8-GPU burst for 7 days in a 31-day billing month we calculate (8 GPUs * daily rate * 7 days). I used your current plan's A100-equivalent daily rate to produce the estimate.

- Credit application: we can apply the unused October burst credit to this invoice — I see a refundable credit of €920 on your account that can be used against one-off add-on charges. Tell me if you want it applied automatically or held for the month-end invoice.

- VAT handling: with a valid EU VAT ID we can zero-rate the supply (intra-EU B2B). Please confirm the VAT ID you pasted (ESB12345678) is the exact registration on your EU VIES record and include the company legal name on the PO.

Attached: proforma_novaforge_20261210.pdf (line items and total). Summary here:
- Burst: 8 GPUs x 7 days = 56 GPU-days
- Unit price (A100-eq daily): €45.00
- Subtotal: €2,520.00
- Applied credit (optional): -€920.00
- VAT (0% with valid VAT ID): €0.00
- Total due: €1,600.00 (if credit applied)

Next steps for us to issue a final invoice:
1) Confirm you want us to apply the October credit (yes/no).
2) Send PO number and confirm legal name + VAT ID as it appears in VIES.
3) If you need the charge captured immediately we can issue an invoice with net-30 payment terms; or we can wait to batch with your month-end invoice — preference?

If you want, I can loop in Collections for an accelerated capture.

Thanks — I can update the pro-forma and re-send within the hour.

Sofia Ivanova

Hi all — brief finance note to make implementation smooth.

Elena: thanks for the VAT ID. Two items to confirm so we process correctly:

1) VAT treatment: we will zero-rate the supply for intra-EU B2B where a valid VIES query returns the VAT ID and the PO includes legal name. If VIES does not validate, we must charge Spanish VAT (21%) and then issue credit once corrected documentation is provided.

2) Credit application: I see the €920 credit tied to the October reserved-burst reversal. We can apply it to this invoice. We will also include an audit line on the invoice that references credit id CR-202610-87 for your accounting. If you prefer, we can keep the credit on the account and apply it to month-end — just confirm.

3) Immediate capture: if you request immediate payment capture we will send a standard invoice and request payment. If you prefer to have this appear on December month-end invoicing we can hold it until 2026-12-31 consolidation. Note: holding to month-end may delay the test depending on your procurement needs.

I've attached the quick calc workbook we used: billing_calc_novaforge.xlsx.

Marissa — please note for the renewal op that this was an ad-hoc burst; no change to committed capacity.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
